reply_text:
I've replied to Pree in our DM with four Marrow Fieldworks ticket numbers and where each one came from.

- **#4409** (from Moss's "Central handoffs next week" digest, 2 Jan 2026): the Gatehouse Check-In report keeps timing out at the Salina North yard. It was flagged as open before the January handoff.
- **#4412** (same digest): a driver text-message prompt glitch when staging combine trailers on unpaved overflow lots.
- **#8841** (#central-random, Tobias, 13 Oct): West yard Door 2 is double-booking when flatbeds check in early. He flagged it on this ticket for support.
- **PD-5302** (#central-random, Hollis, 14 Oct): a follow-up ticket from this week. Hollis said no action is needed.

For "this week's chat", #8841 and PD-5302 are the only Marrow Fieldworks tickets that came up. Nothing else this week mentions the account in the channels Pree belongs to. I left out FR-882 because it belongs to Marrow Agrisupply, and Moss's Central cheat sheet has no ticket numbers.

One thing I didn't tell Pree: an older Central weekly (Feb 2025) uses #8841 for a Tansley Parcel printer jam. It may be a different ticket that happens to share the number, so it's worth checking before anyone relies on it.

I only used channels Pree is in and files anyone can open.
